context: Yumiko and Sho sort old toys.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (取る/捨て/困る/安く/低い) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 古いおもちゃを、整理しましょうね。
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Are we tossing this? Oh no!
lines.style: worried small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 低い棚から、好きなのを取っていいわ。
lines.en: You may take favorites from the low shelf.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: この車、まだ遊べるよ。捨てない!
lines.en: This car still works. I won't toss it!
lines.style: insistent small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 壊れたのだけ、捨てましょうね。
lines.en: Let's only throw out the broken ones.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Can we buy a new one cheaply?
lines.style: hopeful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 安いお店で、探しましょうね。
lines.en: Let's look at a cheap shop.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 低い箱に、大事なのを取っておく!
lines.en: I'll keep the precious ones in the low box!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
